title: Plus One
statement: `digits` represents a non-negative integer, most significant digit first, with no leading zeros except the number 0. Return the digits of that integer plus one.
hints: Add one to the last digit. If it is less than 10, you are done.
A 9 becomes 0 and the carry moves left.
If the carry survives the first digit, the result is 1 followed by zeros.

approaches.name: Convert to an integer
approaches.explanation: Easy in Python, and it hides the carry.

editorial: Walk from the least significant digit. A digit below 9 increments and returns. A 9 becomes 0 and the walk continues. If every digit was 9, insert a leading 1.
